responses: Hello! I am your AI linguistic chatbot. Ask me a question or use the microphone.
This project is a browser-based chatbot that understands text queries, supports voice interaction, and combines fixed intent replies with AI fallback.
Keyword-only bots are rigid and text-only systems reduce accessibility. This chatbot improves interaction by combining controlled intent replies, AI fallback, and voice support.
The main goal is to build an intelligent chatbot that identifies user intent, gives meaningful replies, supports voice input and output, and uses Gemini for unmatched queries.
The stack includes HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python Flask, JSON intents, Gemini API, browser speech recognition, and speech synthesis.
The flow is simple: user input goes to the Flask API, the engine checks JSON intents, Gemini answers unmatched questions when configured, and the UI returns text plus optional spoken output.
Voice input is handled in the browser with speech recognition. Spoken replies use speech synthesis so users can listen to the chatbot response.
The proposed timeline starts with research and requirements, then conversation design, Flask development, Gemini integration, UI refinement, voice module, testing, report, and demo.
The deliverables include a responsive AI linguistic chatbot web app, voice input and spoken response, testing results, project report, and demo.
Thank you! Have a great day.
